ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (38) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

Mazzini's quotation of the Lord's Prayer in its Slavonic form («да приидет царствие твое», da priidet tsarstvie tvoe, 'thy kingdom come') is rendered in the archaic register; «соблазн» (soblazn) is 'temptation' and «церковное христианство» (tserkovnoe khristianstvo) 'church Christianity'. In Lamennais the idols «честь» (chest', 'honor') and «верность» (vernost', 'loyalty') stay lowercase as printed.
